Definition: neuter plural of a derivative of G1078; birthday ceremonies:--birthday.
BiblicalUsage: genésia means birthday. It turns up twice, in Matthew and Mark.
TheologicalSignificance: I read genésia plainly: birthday, and I leave it there.
RelatedEvents: The Feeding of the Five Thousand; The Death of John the Baptist
